heroHeadline: ICE Officer Shoots and Wounds Venezuelan DoorDash Driver in North Austin, Sparking Protests
heroSubtitle: An ICE officer shot and wounded Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, a 28-year-old Venezuelan DoorDash driver, in North Austin on Sept 20, 2026 during a license-plate-check operation, drawing roughly 100 protesters and a public rebuke from Mayor Kirk Watson; it is at least the third shooting involving federal immigration agents in Texas this year, following the fatal July 7 shooting of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo in Houston. The incident follows a Sept 19 targeted operation in Sedona, Arizona that netted two arrests, and comes amid renewed scrutiny of ICE conduct toward U.S. citizens after viral video showed agents detaining and allegedly striking two citizen teens near an Alamo, Texas elementary school on Sept 11. Separately, the White House withdrew Lance Schroyer's nomination to lead ICE on Sept 17 after Sen. Rand Paul withheld a confirmation hearing pending answers on civilian deaths during ICE operations, and reporting published Sept 15–17 found ICE has no miscarriage data for pregnant detainees between October 2025 and June 2026 despite DHS's claim that it reports the figures monthly.
